$description: Semantic tokens: what each value is for. This tier is what screens and components read, through the CSS variables and Tailwind classes built from it. Values are references into primitives.tokens.json; light and dark live under $extensions.mode. Usage notes for agents live under $extensions["com.cafoo"] as usage (kebab-case use cases) and rules ("Never" and "Only" sentences).

color.$description: Semantic colours: what a value is for. Every name here becomes a CSS variable and a Tailwind class (bg-*, text-*, border-*, fill-*, stroke-*).

com.cafoo.rules: Only for the page itself and full-bleed sections. Never as a card or control fill; that is surface.
Only on canvas or subtle. Never stacked on another surface without a border between them.

surface.$description: Cards, panels, dialogs, inputs: anything that sits on the canvas.

on-surface.$description: Text and icons on surface. Same as ink today; kept as a pair so the two can part later.

com.cafoo.rules: Only as a fill. Never as text.

subtle.$description: A quieter fill: hovered rows, neutral chips, dividers made of fill.

ink-2.$description: Secondary text: descriptions, table body cells that are not the key figure.

com.cafoo.rules: Only for text at caption size or larger. Never for all-caps eyebrows; eyebrows are sentence case.

ink-3.$description: Tertiary text: eyebrows, captions, placeholders, inactive icons.

com.cafoo.rules: Only this colour for borders and dividers. Never a coloured border, not even for status; use a soft fill instead.

line.$description: The one border. Every box uses it; differences between boxes show through fill, never through border colour.

com.cafoo.rules: Only on interactive controls. Never on cards or dividers; those use line.

line-strong.$description: Border for controls that need a firmer edge: buttons, fields, the drill underline.

accent.$description: Neon ocean blue. The one main action on a screen, selection, and the live cursor.

com.cafoo.rules: Never more than one primary action per view. Never for status, badges or informational text; status has its own colours and info is neutral. Only with on-accent for text placed on it.

on-accent.$description: Tar text on the accent. The accent is light, so its text is always dark, in both modes.

com.cafoo.rules: Only on accent fills. Never white text on the accent.
Only for text and icons. Never as a fill; the fill is accent.

accent-ink.$description: The brand colour as text: links, drill targets, the Advisor's name.

com.cafoo.rules: Only as a fill paired with on-accent-soft for its text. Never for status.

accent-soft.$description: Accent container: selected rows, the chosen segment, highlights.

com.cafoo.rules: Only in the marketing artwork and decorative gradients. Never as a text or control colour; it fails contrast for text.

accent-deep.$description: The deep ocean of the painted brushwork. Artwork, not UI.

com.cafoo.rules: Only for meaning, never for decoration. Only as text on canvas or surface, or as a fill with on-pos.

pos.$description: Positive: money in, matched, reconciled, approved.

com.cafoo.rules: Only as a fill paired with on-pos-soft.

pos-soft.$description: Positive container for badges and highlighted rows.

on-pos.$description: Text on a solid pos fill.

com.cafoo.rules: Only for meaning, never for decoration. Only as text on canvas or surface, or as a fill with on-neg. Never the accent for errors.

neg.$description: Negative: money out, failed, rejected, over budget.

com.cafoo.rules: Only as a fill paired with on-neg-soft.

neg-soft.$description: Negative container for badges, error rows and inline error messages.

on-neg.$description: Text on a solid neg fill.

com.cafoo.rules: Only for meaning, never for decoration. Only as text on canvas or surface, or as a fill with on-warn.

warn.$description: Warning: needs a look, not yet wrong.

com.cafoo.rules: Only as a fill paired with on-warn-soft.

warn-soft.$description: Warning container for badges and banners.

on-warn.$description: Text on a solid warn fill.

com.cafoo.rules: Never blue; blue is the accent and means an action. Only as text on canvas or surface, or as a fill with on-info.

info.$description: Informational: a note, a hint, a neutral status. Deliberately grey, so a note never looks like an action.

com.cafoo.rules: Only as a fill paired with on-info-soft. Never as a hover fill; that is subtle.

info-soft.$description: Info container for neutral badges and notes. One step firmer than subtle, so a badge stays visible on a hovered row.

on-info-soft.$description: Text and icons on info-soft. One step darker than info so it stays readable on the firmer fill.

on-info.$description: Text on a solid info fill.

scrim.$description: The dimmer behind dialogs and sheets.

com.cafoo.rules: Only behind a dialog, sheet or command palette. Never as a tint on content.
Only for small transient surfaces. Never for a whole page or card. Only with on-inverse for its text.

inverse.$description: A surface that flips the mode: toasts, tooltips, the command palette's footer.

com.cafoo.rules: Only for :focus-visible outlines and rings. Never removed without a replacement that passes 3:1.

focus.$description: The focus ring. Tar in light mode, ocean in dark mode, always 3:1 against the page.

com.cafoo.rules: Only as a fill paired with on-tag-leave-soft. Never for status; a tag says what kind of day it is, not whether it is good news.

tag-leave-soft.$description: Calendar tag container: vacation, parental and other planned leave.

com.cafoo.rules: Only as a fill paired with on-tag-sick-soft. Never for status; a tag says what kind of day it is, not whether it is good news.
Only as a fill paired with on-tag-pay-soft. Never for status; a tag says what kind of day it is, not whether it is good news.

tag-pay-soft.$description: Calendar tag container: paydays and payroll debits.

com.cafoo.rules: Only as a fill paired with on-tag-due-soft. Never for status; a tag says what kind of day it is, not whether it is good news.

tag-due-soft.$description: Calendar tag container: bill and invoice due dates.

com.cafoo.rules: Only as a fill paired with on-tag-holiday-soft. Never for status; a tag says what kind of day it is, not whether it is good news.

tag-holiday-soft.$description: Calendar tag container: public and company holidays. Neutral on purpose, so a day off reads as quiet.

role.$description: One colour per agent role, for avatars, names and the debate thread. Classes: bg-role-*, text-role-*, fill-role-*.

com.cafoo.rules: Only for the Advisor's avatar, name and message rail. Never as a generic accent.

advisor.$description: The Advisor, who rules on proposals. Shares the brand hue because it speaks for the system.

funding.$description: The Funding desk agent, which matches investor money to the round.

capital.$description: The Capital accountant agent, which records SAFEs, notes and shares.

cfo.$description: The CFO, the human in the loop.

type.$description: The type scale, by role. Classes: text-micro … text-display set size, line height and tracking; weight is a separate utility (font-medium) and the fontWeight here is the recommended pairing. Headings add font-display.

micro.$description: Tiny labels: axis ticks, keyboard hints, badge text.

caption.$description: Captions, eyebrows, table meta, helper text.

com.cafoo.rules: Only in sentence case. Never all caps, even with letter spacing.

body-sm.$description: Dense body: table cells, lists, secondary copy.

subtitle.$description: Card headers, KPI labels, the line under a page title.

display-sm.$description: Page titles and the key figure on a report.

display.$description: The hero and the one number that matters on a screen.

com.cafoo.rules: Only once per screen. Never for body copy or inside cards.

shape.$description: Corner radii. Classes: rounded-sm, rounded-md, rounded-lg, rounded-xl; rounded-full stays Tailwind's pill.

com.cafoo.rules: Only one radius per component. Never a different radius on a nested element unless it is a control.

lg.$description: Large flat panels on the marketing page.
